snippet.title: IT: Welcome to Derry (2025) | Episode 5 Trailer | HBO Max
snippet.description:
#ITWelcomeToDerry 

🎥 Attention viewers! (ITS FAN MADE)
Return to the terrifying town of Derry in IT: Welcome to Derry as the legend of Pennywise unfolds like never before. In this chilling new HBO Max series from the Muschietti siblings and inspired by Stephen King’s iconic universe, dark secrets resurface and horror returns to haunt the next generation. Don’t miss the spine-tingling promos and final trailer for episodes 5 and 6—evil has come home.

The inspiration behind this video:
Step back into the terrifying world of Stephen King with Welcome to Derry, the chilling new prequel series to IT. In this Final Trailer, Pennywise's origins begin to surface in the haunting town of Derry, where nightmares are real and the shadows hide unspeakable horrors. Starring Jovan Adepo and Taylour Paige, and featuring creative direction by Andy Muschietti and Barbara Muschietti, this HBO Max Original Series dives deep into the twisted legacy of It. Fans of the IT movies and horror classics will finally return to where the terror began.

From HBO, HBO Max, and HBO Originals comes a fresh yet horrifying vision of the Stephen King universe. This spine-chilling series blends the iconic terror of Pennywise with a gripping narrative, delivering high-stakes suspense, emotional depth, and brutal scares. Welcome to Derry continues the tradition of acclaimed HBO Max Originals, joining titles like House of the Dragon and The Last of Us, and solidifying HBO Max as the home for the best horror and thriller series.

Stay tuned for more promos, including Welcome to Derry Episode 5 Promo and Welcome to Derry Episode 6 Promo. For fans of deep lore, dark mystery, and haunting performances, this series is a must-watch. Watch more from top entertainment channels like Teaser PRO, FilmSpot Trailer, MovieGasm, KinoCheck, EmergencyAwesome, IGN TV Trailer, and TV Promos. Don't miss the next chapter in terror — Pennywise is back, and Derry will never be the same.

snippet.title: Toni Braxton - "He Wasn't Man Enough" Film (Trailer)
snippet.description:
#ToniBraxton #YvetteNicoleBrown #EssenceAtkins

The all-new original film, Toni Braxton’s He Wasn’t Man Enough, is inspired by Grammy® Award winner Toni Braxton’s best-selling hit of the same name and Braxton executive produces and stars alongside NAACP Image Award nominee Essence Attkins and Emmy® nominee Yvette Nicole Brown.

Set to premiere Saturday, November 22 at 8/7c as part of the network’s Love of a Lifetime November romance movie slate, He Wasn’t Man Enough, stars Braxton as bestselling author Mel Montgomery, whose world unravels when she discovers her boyfriend Richard (Thomas Cadrot) has been deceiving her. When Mel learns Richard is now engaged to her estranged college friend Monica (Atkins), the two women, with the help of Mel’s loyal best friend Candy (Brown), set aside old wounds to stand together. What begins as betrayal becomes a story of resilience and solidarity—proving Richard picked the wrong trio to mess with. Because in the end, it was never about the man who failed them, but the women who chose each other.  Always and without question… sisters over misters.

#ToniBraxtonHeWasntManEnough
